subject: ghost-haven
label: There have never been condoms
from: Condoms, invented by the Archive inside a joke it also invented
to: NONE. EVER. Lube, six gallons a day, bought by the drum
note:
THE ARCHIVE MADE ONE UP AND IT DID NOT SURVIVE THE HOUR. Writing the camping prep, it put a line in Torie's mouth about a packing list reading FORTY-ONE CONDOMS AND A WILL. The joke was invented whole — no source, no beat behind it, nothing but a plausible-sounding shape — and Viraena struck it down at the table the moment she read it.

THE FAMILY HAS NEVER USED A CONDOM. Not on any trip, not in any house, not once. The largest condom manufactured fits SIX INCHES; Ivy, who carries the smallest cock on the compound at 7.0", clears it by an inch. The product does not exist in a size any woman here could use, and nothing in this house is done for prevention in the first place.

WHAT THE SENTENCE SHOULD HAVE SAID is lube. A week off-property needs A WEEK'S SUPPLY, and the daily figure is six gallons.

FILED AS THE SAME CLASS OF ERROR AS c-universe-four: the Archive assembled a category that sounded right and then furnished it. It has now done this twice in one week, both times inside a joke, which is where it seems to happen.
